status_definitions.established: Well-powered, out-of-sample or externally validated, no material caveat remaining
status_definitions.supported_but_limited: Real, positive evidence exists but scope/power/generality is bounded
status_definitions.not_established: Formally tested and inconclusive/underpowered, or never formally tested
status_definitions.contradicted: Current wording is directly refuted by artifact data; a narrower true version may still exist
